name: TemplateRuntime
purpose: Keep compilation, compiled-artifact refresh and final-page caching as independent policies.

Compile.invariant: mode selects exactly one artifact representation; both modes normalize the request before rendering; generatedRenderer is required only for gen

GeneratedRequest.invariant: is created only after the same assign/define/env normalization used by AST mode

PreparedRender.invariant: ast and gen prepared requests expose the same render operation and repeat semantics

types.GeneratedArtifact: typed host-language renderer plus source version

semantics.ast: Compile source to AST and interpret the AST.
semantics.gen: Compile source to host-language renderer code and call the generated renderer.
semantics.dev: Refresh the selected compiled artifact on every call.
semantics.true: Reuse the compiled artifact until its source version changes.
semantics.false: Use the deployed compiled artifact without runtime refresh.
semantics.page_cache: Stores the final HTML produced from template, define and assign inputs; a hit bypasses business logic and template rendering.
semantics.page_cache_ttl: A positive value expires after that many seconds; 0 and null mean forever.

request.invariant: assign is root data and define is the template registry; they are not interchangeable. The generated renderer receives the normalized target, bound assign, bound define and resolved env.

operations.name: compile
operations.returns: AST artifact or generated host-language artifact
errors: lex, parse, code generation and compilation errors

operations.name: loadOrRefresh
errors: stale or missing artifact, source and artifact mismatch
